caption: The drawing depicts two ceramic jugs, one above the other, both outlined in a dark ink or pencil on a plain, off-white background. The jug on the top is relatively simple in shape with a narrow neck and a small opening; it features a single blue decorative motif resembling a stylized leaf or feather at its center. The jug below has a similar shape, but is slightly broader, has a handle on the right side, and displays two blue decorative motifs—one on the shoulder to the left and another near the upper part of the handle. Both jugs have minimalistic detailing with just the blue color used for the motifs and the outlines kept simple. There is a small linear scale centered below the second jug, marked in increments, and a signature is present in the bottom right corner. Light tan or brown spots are scattered sporadically across the paper, likely from age or staining.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
